name: do-memory-mcp-server
description: Self-Learning Memory MCP Server - Episodic memory with pattern extraction and intelligent retrieval

tools.name: query_memory
tools.description: Query episodic memory for relevant past experiences and learned patterns

tools.name: analyze_patterns
tools.description: Analyze patterns from past episodes to identify successful strategies

tools.name: health_check
tools.description: Check the health status of the MCP server and its components

tools.name: get_metrics
tools.description: Get monitoring metrics and statistics. Use metric_type 'retrieval' for CSM tier distribution, cache hit rates, embedding-call rates, fallback reasons, and P95 latencies.

tools.name: advanced_pattern_analysis
tools.description: Perform advanced statistical analysis, predictive modeling, and causal inference on time series data from memory episodes

tools.name: quality_metrics
tools.description: Retrieve memory quality metrics and noise reduction statistics from the PREMem system

tools.name: configure_embeddings
tools.description: Configure semantic embedding provider for enhanced memory retrieval.

tools.name: query_semantic_memory
tools.description: Search episodic memory using semantic similarity with embeddings.

tools.name: test_embeddings
tools.description: Test embedding provider connectivity.

tools.name: generate_embedding
tools.description: Generate an embedding vector for text using the configured embedding provider.

tools.name: search_by_embedding
tools.description: Search episodes by embedding similarity using a pre-computed embedding vector.

tools.name: embedding_provider_status
tools.description: Get detailed status information about the configured embedding provider.

tools.name: search_patterns
tools.description: Search for patterns semantically similar to a query using multi-signal ranking

tools.name: recommend_patterns
tools.description: Get pattern recommendations for a specific task with high-quality filtering

tools.name: recommend_playbook
tools.description: Get an actionable playbook with step-by-step guidance for a task (ADR-044 Feature 1)

tools.name: explain_pattern
tools.description: Get a human-readable explanation of a pattern including when to use it and expected outcomes

tools.name: record_recommendation_session
tools.description: Record a recommendation session when patterns/playbooks are suggested to an agent

tools.name: record_recommendation_feedback
tools.description: Record feedback about which recommendations were used and the outcome

tools.name: get_recommendation_stats
tools.description: Get statistics about recommendation effectiveness and adoption rates

tools.name: checkpoint_episode
tools.description: Create a checkpoint for an in-progress episode. Use this when switching agents, pausing long-running tasks, or before risky operations.

tools.name: get_handoff_pack
tools.description: Generate a handoff pack from a checkpoint. Compact mode (default) returns a byte-budgeted profile with findings, decisions, pending actions, and omission receipts; full mode returns the unbounded pack for audit/debug.

tools.name: resume_from_handoff
tools.description: Resume work from a handoff pack. Creates a new episode initialized with context from a previous checkpoint for seamless task continuation.

tools.name: bulk_episodes
tools.description: Retrieve multiple episodes by their IDs in a single efficient operation

tools.name: create_episode
tools.description: Create a new episode to track task execution programmatically

tools.name: add_episode_step
tools.description: Add an execution step to an ongoing episode to track progress

tools.name: complete_episode
tools.description: Complete an episode with an outcome and trigger the learning cycle (reward, reflection, patterns)

tools.name: get_episode
tools.description: Get complete details of an episode including steps, outcome, reflection, and patterns

tools.name: delete_episode
tools.description: Delete an episode permanently from all storage backends (requires confirmation)

tools.name: update_episode
tools.description: Update episode fields (description, tags, metadata)

tools.name: get_episode_timeline
tools.description: Get a chronological timeline view of all steps in an episode

tools.name: add_episode_tags
tools.description: Add tags to an episode. Tags are validated and normalized (lowercase, trimmed). Duplicate tags are ignored.

tools.name: remove_episode_tags
tools.description: Remove tags from an episode. Non-existent tags are silently ignored. Matching is case-insensitive.

tools.name: set_episode_tags
tools.description: Set/replace all tags on an episode. Useful for complete tag reorganization. Empty tag list will clear all tags.

tools.name: get_episode_tags
tools.description: Get tags for an episode

tools.name: search_episodes_by_tags
tools.description: Search episodes by tags using AND or OR logic. Matching is case-insensitive.

tools.name: add_episode_relationship
tools.description: Add a relationship between two episodes with validation

tools.name: remove_episode_relationship
tools.description: Remove a relationship by ID

tools.name: get_episode_relationships
tools.description: Get relationships for an episode

tools.name: find_related_episodes
tools.description: Find episodes related to a given episode

tools.name: check_relationship_exists
tools.description: Check if a specific relationship exists

tools.name: get_dependency_graph
tools.description: Get relationship graph for visualization

tools.name: validate_no_cycles
tools.description: Check if adding a relationship would create a cycle

tools.name: get_topological_order
tools.description: Get topological ordering of episodes

tools.name: configure_agentfs
tools.description: Configure AgentFS external signal provider for reward system integration.

tools.name: external_signal_status
tools.description: Get status of configured external signal providers for the reward system.

tools.name: test_agentfs_connection
tools.description: Test connectivity to the AgentFS external signal provider.

tools.name: resume_from_compact
tools.description: Resume work from a compact handoff pack. Creates a new episode initialized with the compact goal, findings, decisions, and pending actions.
